    "palette": "grey fog cyan-grey #4A5A5C as the global base, ink shadow #171B1D with detail kept in the darks, plaster white #C6C2B8 for ceramic shells, pure-fire white #F5F7F8 and black #0B0B0C for the twin colour bone pattern, ember orange #E07B39 as the only warm accent",
    "material_language": "real skin with pores and slight oil sheen, matte technical fabric with wear and dust, oxidised steel with dull reflections, cold ceramic shells on altered bodies; no wet gore surface and no red liquid in the whole frame",
    "environment_design": "cement yard plates cut by fissures and pit openings, riveted steel frames, sheet metal fence runs with gate gaps, overhead pipe racks, stairwells and a single cold ceiling tube as the only interior light",
    "prop_design": "functional utilitarian tooling with real weight and thickness: crowbars, ration crates, steel racks, cable reels, console terminals, rolled roller doors, restraint cuffs and an unlit shadow blade; all carry visible use marks",
    "lighting_and_atmosphere": "one cold overhead key with shadow detail retained instead of crushed black, cold grey bounce from concrete and steel, the black and white twin flame as the only moving light source, and industrial weld sparks as the only warm light in the frame"
